sourceRef: Sage Payroll Tax Pocket Guide 2025-2026 s2.2.2; https://www.sars.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/Ops/Guides/PAYE-GEN-01-G21-Guide-for-Employers-iro-Employees-Tax-for-2027-External-Guide.pdf p. 31
notes: R50 000 paid to a personal service trust (code 3601, G21 p. 31). Sage\’s pocket guide s2.2.2: a PSP is taxed at 27% (company) or 45% (trust), so PAYE = 45% x 50 000 = 22500.00; s12.1: all legal entities are excluded from UIF, so UIF 0.00. UNVERIFIED: G21 2027 p. 31 says only to calculate employees tax on such payments in the same manner as tax on a bonus, which does not give the flat rate; the two disagree.
